app.name: Frenemy Cards
app.shareTagline: Turn your friends into roast cards. Then battle it out.

home.tagline: Turn your friends into collectible cards that roast their worst habits: always late, never replies, "next time I'll pay."
home.make: Make a card for a friend
home.hint: Send it to them and see how they strike back 😏
home.exampleLabel: Example card: Sam, Late type, SSR

share.message: Your card just dropped 😂 Take a look:
share.copied: Link copied ✅ Paste it into WhatsApp
share.copiedInstead: Sharing isn't available here, so the link was copied instead ✅
share.failed: That didn't work 😵 Try long-pressing the card to save it, or try again
share.photoNote: 📸 This image has your friend's real photo on it. Check they're fine with it before it goes to a group or anywhere public 😉 Links never carry the photo: whoever opens one sees the original artwork.

view.title: {from} made you a card 😏
view.intro: Frenemy Cards: turn your friends into collectible cards that roast their worst habits.
view.bad: It may be incomplete or broken. Ask your friend to send it again, or make your own card!
view.newer: This card was made with a newer version. Refresh the page and try again.
view.unsupported: Your browser is too old to open this card. Try the latest Chrome or Safari.

reveal.title: Open the pack!
reveal.challenge: ⚔️ Challenge a friend with this card
reveal.yourNameHint: So your friend knows who to strike back at. Optional.

reaction.R: An R card! {name} is worth something after all
reaction.SR: SR! Since when was {name} this rare?

builder.reminder: Keep the roast friendly so everyone keeps playing 😉
builder.blocked: Let's keep it friendly. Try different words 🙏

avatar.title: Give them a look
avatar.styleHint: Pick a starting look, then change anything you like

confirm.text: Once the rarity is rolled, the card can't be changed. Ready?

scene.title: Choose a scene
scene.hint: Pick a scene. The card will use this illustration.

photo.title: 📷 Add your friend's photo
photo.hint: Optional: just tap Next to skip. The photo goes on the character's head, like a sticker.
photo.fit: Fit your friend's whole head (hair too) in the circle. Drag to line it up.
photo.preview: Your card will look like this:
photo.error: That photo won't open. Try another one.
photo.privacy: 🔒 The photo only stays on your phone and in images you send. It never goes into links. Ask your friend before using their photo 😉
photo.unavailable: Photos aren't available for this type yet.

look.title: Boy or girl?
look.hint: The card uses this type's illustration

stats.title: Hand out the stats
stats.hint: You have {total} points, up to {max} per stat. A zero for On Time? Totally allowed 😏

desc.title: Sum them up in one line
desc.label: Your line

work.name: Workaholic
work.idea: "Let me just reply to this email"

error.load: Couldn't load the data. Check your connection and try again 🙏

album.title: My album
album.hint: Cards live on this phone only (up to {max}). Clearing browser data or switching phones loses them, so Export a backup!
album.tapHint: Tap a card to see it big 👀
album.empty: No cards yet. Make one for a friend, or wait for a friend to send you one!
album.noStorage: This browser can't keep cards (maybe a private window or an in-app browser). Everything else works, but the album stays empty.

collection.title: Friend Collection
collection.hint: Pick up to {max} cards to turn into one image for your IG Story or WhatsApp.
collection.shareMessage: Check out my Frenemy Collection 😂 Make one of me:

export.title: Export album
export.text: This link holds all {n} of your cards. Open it on your new phone or another browser to import them.
export.warn: The link contains all your cards, so just send it to yourself.

import.title: Import album
import.full: The album holds up to {max} cards; if it fills up, the oldest cards drop off.
import.already: All of these cards are already in your album ✅

challenge.title: Start a challenge 🥊
challenge.pickCard: Pick a card to fight with
challenge.noCards: No cards on this phone yet. Make one first, or wait for a friend to send you one!
challenge.penalty: What does the loser have to do?
challenge.sentHint: Send it to a friend. The fight starts the moment they accept 😏
challenge.shareMessage: I challenge you 🥊 Loser has to: {penalty}! Tap to accept:

attack.desc: Hit harder, but take more hits

defend.name: 🛡️ Defend

chaos.name: 🎲 Chaos
chaos.desc: Wild swings. Pray to the luck gods

accept.pickCard: Pick your card to fight with

accept.makeNew: ✏️ Make a new card to fight with
accept.tacticHint: They picked a tactic too. You'll find out when it starts 🤫

result.locked: 🔒 You already answered this challenge. The result is final.
